column3: The iPad screen shows the Due Meld HOME screen recreated from the attached screenshot as a centred column layout: “Sunday, November 1”, huge bold plum “1 overdue, 2 due this week.”, “$639.49 due in the next 30 days”, a row of day chips, a plum card “Next up · submit to Lakeside Elementary · School trip form · 2 days left · $25.00” with a marigold check, rows “OCT 29 · Property tax, 2nd instalment · 3 days late · $186.50” and “NOV 7 · Car insurance · In 6 days · $412.00”, a floating bottom tab bar and a round marigold camera button. In FRONT of the iPad at the lower left, a real paper renewal letter lies on a warm wooden table with its date line glowing marigold, and a glossy iOS notification floats over the top right corner of the iPad: “DUE MELD · 9:00 AM”, bold “Car insurance renews in 7 days”, “Reminders 30, 7 and 1 days before”.

The iPad screen shows the Due Meld CHECK IT screen recreated from the attached screenshot as a centred column: title “Check it”, huge bold plum “We found 2 deadlines”, “Check the dates. You’re the final say.”, two small page thumbnails, a card “Deadline 1 of 2” with “Due date · November 13, 2026”, a marigold-edged quote “Please return the completed form by November 13, 2026.”, “What is it? · School enrolment form”, chips Renew, Pay, Submit (selected plum), Cancel; a second card “Deadline 2 of 2” with “November 27, 2026” and quote “Fees of $180.00 are due by the end of the month.”; a wide marigold button “Save 2 items”. OUTSIDE the iPad on the left, a real paper school letter with those two sentences highlighted in glowing marigold, each joined to its quote on the screen by a thin glowing marigold line.

The iPad screen shows the Due Meld DEADLINE DETAIL screen recreated from the attached screenshot as a centred column: date tile “NOV 7”, small label “Insurance”, big bold “Car insurance”, pill “In 6 days”; card “What to do · Renew by November 7, 2026 · From Harbor Mutual · $412.00”; a marigold-edged card “Found in the letter · Your policy renews on November 7, 2026.”; “Reminders at 9:00 AM” list: “30 days before · Sent”, “7 days before · Sent”, “1 day before · Fri, Nov 6”, “On the day · Sat, Nov 7”; bottom buttons “Snooze” and “Mark done” (marigold). Floating over the upper left corner of the iPad, a large glossy iOS notification: “DUE MELD · 9:00 AM”, bold “Car insurance renews in 7 days”, “$412 · Renew with Harbor Mutual”, buttons “Done” (green) and “Snooze”, with a small glowing marigold bell nearby.

The iPad screen shows the Due Meld HOUSEHOLD screen recreated from the attached screenshot as a centred column: a plum hero card “Household · The Riveras · 2 people share these deadlines. Assign who handles what.” with chips “2 of 5 people” and “Private to your household”; field “Household name · The Riveras”; “Members”: “Dana Rivera · Owner · You” and “Sam Rivera · Member” with round avatars D and S; “Waiting to join · Code K7PQ2M · Expires Nov 6 · Revoke”; a wide marigold button “Invite someone”. Floating OUTSIDE the iPad on the right, two glossy white deadline cards linked by glowing marigold lines to avatar bubbles D and S: “NOV 2 · Water bill · Dana handles this · $86.20” and “NOV 9 · Car registration · Sam handles this · $168”.

The iPad screen shows the Due Meld ALL ITEMS screen recreated from the attached screenshot as a centred column: big bold “All items”, search field “Search titles, issuers, notes”, segmented “Open” (selected) / “Done”, chips “All” (plum), “ID & travel”, “Vehicle”, “Home”, “Insurance”, “Bills & money”; section “October 2026” row “OCT 29 · Property tax, 2nd instalment · 3 days late · $186.50”; section “November 2026” rows “NOV 3 · School trip form · In 2 days · $25.00”, “NOV 7 · Car insurance · In 6 days · $412.00”, “NOV 19 · Streaming free trial · In 18 days · $15.99”, “NOV 25 · Dentist check-up · In 24 days”; section “January 2027” row “JAN 15 · Car registration · In 75 days · $84.00”. Floating around the iPad edges, small glossy category badges with icons: shield “Insurance”, car “Vehicle”, passport “ID & travel”, house “Home”, receipt “Bills”.
